headline: Hamza Choudhury makes immediate impact as Sheffield United secure first league win
summary: Hamza Choudhury, the Bangladesh captain, debuted for Sheffield United just a day after his permanent move, playing a key role in their dramatic 3-2 victory over Bolton Wanderers.
details: Hamza Choudhury made an impressive full-match debut for Sheffield United, contributing significantly to their first league victory of the season. The Blades secured a dramatic 3-2 win over Bolton Wanderers at Bramall Lane.

Just one day after completing his permanent transfer, the Bangladesh captain was immediately handed a starting position in midfield by manager Chris Wilder. He responded with a composed and energetic performance.

The match saw Bolton take an early lead in the first minute, but Sheffield United quickly equalized through Japhet Tanganga in the fourth minute. Hamza played a crucial role in maintaining composure during this frenetic opening.
The 28-year-old midfielder completed 45 of his 50 passes, achieving a 90 percent accuracy rate. He was also highly effective defensively, winning all four of his tackles.
Bolton regained the lead in the 67th minute with a goal from Sam Dalby. However, Sheffield United responded almost instantly, with Patrick Bamford leveling the score in the 68th minute.

The game culminated in a dramatic finish at Bramall Lane. Romelle Donovan scored the decisive winner in the 93rd minute, completing Sheffield United's comeback and securing their first league victory of the campaign.

headline: New rates: Primary scholarship students to get 300 and 225 taka monthly
summary: The Directorate of Primary Education has set new monthly allowance rates for Talentpool and General scholarship holders for the next three years.
details: The Directorate of Primary Education has announced new scholarship rates for students selected based on the 2025 Primary Scholarship Examination results. These new rates will be effective for three years starting from January 1, 2026.

Students selected for the Talentpool scholarship will receive 300 taka per month, while General scholarship holders will receive 225 taka per month. Additionally, both categories of scholarship recipients will receive a one-time annual payment of 225 taka.
To maintain the scholarship, students must adhere to specific conditions, including good conduct, regular school attendance, and satisfactory academic progress.
Scholarship holders will also be eligible for free admission to any government or recognized private secondary and lower-secondary schools across the country.

The funds will be transferred directly to the students' bank accounts via Electronic Fund Transfer (EFT) using individual or G2P methods. Parents are required to open accounts in scheduled banks with online facilities.

All scholarship funds must be withdrawn by June 30 of each fiscal year. The Director General of the Directorate of Primary Education retains the authority to correct, cancel, or redistribute the scholarship list.
